title: Casper and the Archive
author: Silas Nystrom
blurb: Oscar Winterbourne, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
